scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,worker,web -c blue,magenta,green "pnpm dev:api" "pnpm dev:worker" "pnpm dev:web"
scripts.dev:api: uv run --project apps/api --extra cpu uvicorn sourcetrace.main:app --reload --port 8000
scripts.dev:worker: uv run --project apps/api --extra cpu dramatiq sourcetrace.workers.tasks --processes 1 --threads 4
scripts.dev:worker:gpu: uv run --project apps/api --extra cu130 dramatiq sourcetrace.workers.tasks --processes 1 --threads 4
scripts.generate:api: uv run --project apps/api --extra cpu python apps/api/scripts/export_openapi.py && pnpm --dir apps/web generate:api
scripts.eval:fake: uv run --project apps/api --extra cpu python -m sourcetrace.evaluation.cli fake --dataset evals/fixtures/dataset-v1.json --observations evals/fixtures/observations-v1.json --metadata evals/fixtures/metadata-v1.json --output output/evals/fixture-report.json
scripts.eval:real: uv run --project apps/api --extra cpu python -m sourcetrace.evaluation.cli real
scripts.eval:rerank: uv run --project apps/api --extra cu130 python -m sourcetrace.evaluation.cli rerank
scripts.eval:review: uv run --project apps/api --extra cpu python -m sourcetrace.evaluation.cli review
scripts.eval:diagnose-assessments: uv run --project apps/api --extra cpu python -m sourcetrace.evaluation.cli diagnose-assessments
scripts.eval:diagnose-citations: uv run --project apps/api --extra cpu python -m sourcetrace.evaluation.cli diagnose-citations
scripts.eval:diagnose-retrieval-stages: uv run --project apps/api --extra cpu python -m sourcetrace.evaluation.cli diagnose-retrieval-stages
scripts.format: uv run --project apps/api --extra cpu ruff format apps/api && pnpm --dir apps/web format
scripts.check: pnpm check:cpu-deps && uv run --project apps/api --extra cpu ruff check apps/api && uv run --project apps/api --extra cpu mypy apps/api/src && pnpm --dir apps/web typecheck
scripts.test:api: uv run --project apps/api --extra cpu pytest apps/api/tests
